M32 — 2026-10-10
A conformance case whose gate must ask git cannot use the pinned .git skeleton: it has no objects, so git status fails and the gate fails open. Use `{ ...synthetic('baseline'), git: undefined }` and run `git init -q -b main` in step 1's before. Steps run within about 2 s of each other, so a time-window assertion needs mtimes well outside the 2 s slack (e.g. +120 s) or a backgrounded (open) window.
